text:
maria: Heads up — PR #3142 is blocked by CI. integ-shard2 is failing intermittently on render_cache_integration.test_timeout. Screenshot attached in CI but stack is noisy. Can I get quick eyes / guidance on snapshot update vs rerun?
ci-bot: build 3142 (shard2) failed: render_cache_integration.test_timeout (timeout after 120s) — logs: https://ci.example/reports/3142/shard2 — rerun link: /rerun/3142/shard2
sam: thanks — can you paste the failing log snippet? sometimes it's the upstream service flake.
maria: sure, pasted below:
```
E   TimeoutError: RPC request to renderer timed out (120s)
  at tests/render_cache_integration.py:78
  last rpc: POST /render -> 504
```
wayne: looks like a transient renderer OOM or network hiccup. Those usually pass on a targeted rerun. i'd try a targeted rerun on shard2 once. if it fails twice in a row, we should bisect.
olivia: fwiw, that test has been flakey historically — see flaky dashboard: https://flaky.internal/reports/render_cache (flakiness score 0.11 last 30d). if you update snapshots without addressing the non-deterministic timeout we might mask a real regression.
maria: good call. i'll do one targeted rerun now. tagging sam + wayne for eyes. :eyes:
ci-bot: queued targeted rerun 3142/shard2 (attempt 1) — started
ci-bot: targeted rerun 3142/shard2 (attempt 1) — PASSED
maria: rerun passed once. rerunning again to be sure.
ci-bot: targeted rerun 3142/shard2 (attempt 2) — FAILED (same timeout)
sam: that pattern (pass then fail) screams flaky infra. can you gather the node logs and the renderer pod logs? also try running that single test locally with --repeat=50 to see failure rate.
maria: grabbing logs now. running repeat locally (won't finish instantly) — will post results.
wayne: if local repeat reproduces >10% failure, let's open a small infra ticket and mark the test flaky for now (skip with issue link) so we can unblock the PR. otherwise, we can do a rerun-to-pass policy: require 2 consecutive green runs in CI before merge.
olivia: agree. prefer rerun-to-pass policy here. if it keeps flipping after 3 reruns, escalate. also cc: @qa-bot to cross-check historical test owner.
qa-bot: test owner for render_cache_integration: @wayne (last touched 2025-09-12). Related infra tickets: INF-721 (renderer restart race), INF-842 (rpc timeouts under load).
maria: local repeat (20 runs) -> 1 failure so far (timeout). i'll queue one more targeted rerun and attach node logs.
ci-bot: targeted rerun 3142/shard2 (attempt 3) — PASSED
maria: OK we have pass/fail/pass pattern. i'm going to follow wayne's suggestion: open INF ticket referencing this PR and request infra triage, and in the short term require 2 consecutive green runs before merge. tagging reviewers: sam, wayne — could you approve if you have no code objections? :pray:
sam: no code objections from me. i'll approve after next green or if you update with a skip + INF ticket.
wayne: same — no objections. please add the INF ticket and a short note in the PR description about flakiness and the merge policy. :+1:
maria: added INF-910 in PR description and attached node logs. i'm going to wait for one more green to merge (or update snapshot only if we get a deterministic failure tied to behavior change). thanks all! :shipit:
